name: twelve-origin forecast test (pre-registered)
cutoff_rule: v6: outcomes up to and including the origin month; forecasts cover the six following months

models.Seasonal naive: same calendar month one year earlier
models.ExtraTrees-36: ExtraTreesRegressor_target_only_features (forecasting_evaluation.py:759; 300 trees, min_samples_leaf 2, seed 42, 16 target-only features, recursive six steps), occupied and available beds, 36 months ending at the origin
models.SARIMA-24: order (1,0,0)(0,1,0,12), trend n, StandardScaler, lbfgs, maxiter 400, all 24 months ending at the origin as labels
models.SARIMA-36: as SARIMA-24 with the 36 months ending at the origin

exclusion_rules: SARIMA non-convergence, or fewer than 12 ExtraTrees training rows for a target: the model-origin is excluded from summaries
hindsight: saved v6 E0 Hindsight plans and scores
seasonal_naive_check: recomputed SN LP must match saved v6 plan and cost within 1e-6 relative

primary.comparison: ExtraTrees-36 vs Seasonal naive, per origin
primary.E1: gap MAE (beds) over the six months: better if lower by more than 5 beds; tie if within 5 beds; otherwise loss
primary.E2: LP realised cost: better if lower by more than 1% of that origin's hindsight cost; tie within that band; otherwise loss

summaries.S2: mean gap MAE and mean LP cost per model
summaries.S3: non-overlapping subsets: offset r = 0..5, origins r and r+6 (0-based in time order); ET-36 vs SN wins/ties/losses per subset
summaries.S4: mean absolute gap error by horizon 1..6 per model

hypothesis: ExtraTrees-36 has lower gap MAE than Seasonal naive at a majority of origins (E1 wins > half of the origins) and lower mean LP cost than Seasonal naive; assessed separately for all 12 and for the 11 excluding Sep 2025
